import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Create a figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))
fig.suptitle('Titanic Survival Analysis: Key Factors', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.00)

# 1. Survival rate by class and sex
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
survival_data = df.groupby(['class', 'sex'])['survived'].mean().reset_index()
survival_pivot = survival_data.pivot(index='class', columns='sex', values='survived')
survival_pivot = survival_pivot.reindex(['First', 'Second', 'Third'])
survival_pivot.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax1, color=['#FF6B9D', '#4A90E2'], width=0.7)
ax1.set_title('Survival Rate by Class and Gender', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Passenger Class', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_ylabel('Survival Rate', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_xticklabels(ax1.get_xticklabels(), rotation=0)
ax1.legend(title='Gender', title_fontsize=9)
ax1.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)
ax1.set_ylim(0, 1)

# 2. Age distribution by survival
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
survived_ages = df[df['survived'] == 1]['age'].dropna()
died_ages = df[df['survived'] == 0]['age'].dropna()
ax2.hist([died_ages, survived_ages], bins=20, label=['Died', 'Survived'], 
         color=['#E74C3C', '#2ECC71'], alpha=0.7, edgecolor='black')
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution by Survival Status', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Age (years)', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_ylabel('Number of Passengers', fontsize=10)
ax2.legend(title='Status', title_fontsize=9)
ax2.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 3. Survival count by embarkation port
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
embark_survival = df.groupby(['embark_town', 'survived']).size().unstack()
embark_survival = embark_survival.reindex(['Southampton', 'Cherbourg', 'Queenstown'])
embark_survival.plot(kind='bar', stacked=True, ax=ax3, 
                     color=['#E74C3C', '#2ECC71'], width=0.6)
ax3.set_title('Passenger Count by Embarkation Port', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Embarkation Port', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_ylabel('Number of Passengers', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_xticklabels(ax3.get_xticklabels(), rotation=30, ha='right')
ax3.legend(['Died', 'Survived'], title='Status', title_fontsize=9)
ax3.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 4. Fare distribution by class and survival
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
for pclass, color in zip(['First', 'Second', 'Third'], ['#9B59B6', '#3498DB', '#E67E22']):
    class_data = df[df['class'] == pclass]
    survived_fare = class_data[class_data['survived'] == 1]['fare'].dropna()
    ax4.scatter(np.random.normal(pclass.replace('First', '1').replace('Second', '2').replace('Third', '3'), 
                                 0.1, len(survived_fare)), 
               survived_fare, alpha=0.4, s=30, color=color, label=f'{pclass} (Survived)')
    
ax4.set_title('Fare Distribution by Class (Survivors Only)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Passenger Class', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_ylabel('Fare (£)', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_xticks([1, 2, 3])
ax4.set_xticklabels(['First', 'Second', 'Third'])
ax4.legend(title='Class', title_fontsize=9, fontsize=8)
ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)
ax4.set_ylim(0, df['fare'].quantile(0.95))

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
